entries.title: II Corinthians 6:1
segments: ¶We then, [as] workers together [with Him] also plead with [you] not to receive the grace of God in vain.

entries.title: II Corinthians 6:2
segments: For He says: "In an acceptable time I have heard you, And in the day of salvation I have helped you." Behold, now [is] the accepted time; behold, now [is] the day of salvation.

entries.title: II Corinthians 6:3
segments: We give no offense in anything, that our ministry may not be blamed.

entries.title: II Corinthians 6:4
segments: But in all [things] we commend ourselves as ministers of God: in much patience, in tribulations, in needs, in distresses,

entries.title: II Corinthians 6:5
segments: in stripes, in imprisonments, in tumults, in labors, in sleeplessness, in fastings;

entries.title: II Corinthians 6:6
segments: by purity, by knowledge, by longsuffering, by kindness, by the Holy Spirit, by sincere love,

entries.title: II Corinthians 6:7
segments: by the word of truth, by the power of God, by the armor of righteousness on the right hand and on the left,

entries.title: II Corinthians 6:8
segments: by honor and dishonor, by evil report and good report; as deceivers, and [yet] true;

entries.title: II Corinthians 6:9
segments: as unknown, and [yet] well known; as dying, and behold we live; as chastened, and [yet] not killed;

entries.title: II Corinthians 6:10
segments: as sorrowful, yet always rejoicing; as poor, yet making many rich; as having nothing, and [yet] possessing all things.

entries.title: II Corinthians 6:11
segments: ¶O Corinthians! We have spoken openly to you, our heart is wide open.

entries.title: II Corinthians 6:12
segments: You are not restricted by us, but you are restricted by your [own] affections.

entries.title: II Corinthians 6:13
segments: Now in return for the same (I speak as to children), you also be open.

entries.title: II Corinthians 6:14
segments: Do not be unequally yoked together with unbelievers. For what fellowship has righteousness with lawlessness? And what communion has light with darkness?

entries.title: II Corinthians 6:15
segments: And what accord has Christ with Belial? Or what part has a believer with an unbeliever?

entries.title: II Corinthians 6:16
segments: And what agreement has the temple of God with idols? For you are the temple of the living God. As God has said: "I will dwell in them And walk among [them]. I will be their God, And they shall be My people."

entries.title: II Corinthians 6:17
segments: Therefore "Come out from among them And be separate, says the Lord. Do not touch what is unclean, And I will receive you."

entries.title: II Corinthians 6:18
segments: "I will be a Father to you, And you shall be My sons and daughters, Says the LORD Almighty."
